name: codex-wezterm-notify
description: Native Windows notifications for Codex and Claude Code, with exact-pane return for WezTerm.

interface.shortDescription: Windows notifications for Codex and Claude Code; enhanced for WezTerm
interface.longDescription: Shows completion and approval notifications with sound, the session name, and response previews for both Codex and Claude Code. Clicking a notification returns you to the session: the exact pane in WezTerm, or the window of the app hosting the terminal elsewhere, including an integrated terminal in VS Code or Cursor.
defaultPrompt: Explain how my Codex and Claude Code WezTerm notifications work
